verdict.rationale: Gladia is API-first, with both async and real-time transcription available programmatically. It also ships an official CLI (`gladia transcribe audio.mp3`) that is explicitly documented as pipe-friendly, writing machine-readable JSON, SRT, or VTT output to stdout 'for scripts and CI'. Together these clearly support headless automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and documented CI specifics such as non-interactive auth via environment variables and exit-code behavior.
